startupChecks: Installed beta launches visibly and preserves existing startup registration.
Repeated installed launch reuses the running production instance.
A changed startup preference survives an installed-app restart.
Original startup choice and saved theme/layout are restored and survive restart.
browserMusicChecks: Native Next reaches the browser and retains the selected player; late artwork recovers.
Artwork-only metadata changes replace the cached image without a title/artist change.
Full browser restart exceeded the 3-second grace (4683 ms); selection cleared and the new session was successfully selected.
Native pause and play control the selected real browser audio element.
hostedInstaller: Built independently from the same application source; its exact binary must pass the publication workflow native test and public checksum validation.
